about_short_description.short_description: Lime is an electric vehicle company that provides e-bike and e-scooter rental services.

product.name: Lime E-Scooter Sharing
product.description: Short-term rental of app-unlocked electric scooters for urban transportation, available in participating cities and campuses.

product.name: Lime E-Bike Sharing
product.description: Short-term rental of shared electric bicycles for urban and campus travel, accessed, unlocked, and paid for through the Lime app.

product.name: Lime App
product.description: A mobile application for finding, unlocking, managing, and paying for Lime electric bike and scooter rentals.

product.name: Seated E-Scooter
product.description: A seated electric scooter offered through Lime’s shared vehicle network for riders who prefer a seated configuration during short urban trips.

product.name: LimePass
product.description: A Lime ride plan that provides eligible users with bundled or subscription-based access to Lime vehicle rentals under applicable local terms.

product.name: Lime Access
product.description: A reduced-cost access program intended to make Lime shared electric bike and scooter rentals more affordable for eligible riders.
